llm.summary: This skill gives coherent, user-confirmed setup and web-retrieval guidance for open-websearch, with some ordinary setup security cautions.

dimensions.detail: Local daemon startup, proxy settings, endpoint configuration, and optional browser-assisted mode are proportionate to a web-search integration, but users should avoid enabling broad insecure TLS or installing packages from privileged shells.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The setup guidance may involve npm installs, Playwright package installation, browser binary downloads, and MCP/client config edits, but it repeatedly requires user confirmation and validation before claiming success.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill limits default retrieval, tells the agent to treat fetched pages as untrusted, and requires confirmation before risky setup actions; the optional insecure TLS fallback should be used narrowly because it weakens page authenticity.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact allows long-lived daemon startup and config edits only after user approval; I found no hidden persistence, memory modification, privilege escalation, destructive action, or credential exfiltration instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose is open-websearch setup and focused live retrieval, and the artifact instructions align with that purpose through search, page fetch, GitHub README fetch, CLI/daemon validation, and setup paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want open-websearch integration. Review any package installs, browser downloads, daemon startup, or MCP/client config edits before approving them, and avoid FETCH_WEB_INSECURE_TLS except for non-sensitive diagnostic fetches where you understand the reduced HTTPS protection.
llm.findings:
[RP1] expected: The Playwright install path is optional and limited to browser-assisted mode, with user confirmation required; the unpinned npm/npx usage is a supply-chain caution but not hidden or purpose-mismatched.
[SQP-3] expected: The Startpage preference is framed as an English-language search heuristic and the skill also supports Chinese-language sources; this is a quality/localization note, not a security concern.
[T08] expected: The unpinned Playwright/browser installation concern is valid as setup hygiene, but installation is disclosed, optional, and gated by confirmation.
[T09] expected: FETCH_WEB_INSECURE_TLS is disclosed as a fallback only for broken certificate chains and scoped to fetchWebContent; users should treat results fetched this way as less trustworthy.
